title: Answer Feedback
description: A quiz with RadioCard options where a Check button disables the RadioGroup, marks the correct answer and the wrong pick with success and danger Badge elements in a RadioCardSlot, and shows the result in a role="status" live region. The same button becomes Try again, keeps focus with accessibleWhenDisabled, and resets the value to null. Use it to check a pick against a right answer with feedback in words, not color alone.
